description: Reporter's screenshot: an editor pane showing the reproduction source next to the browser output it produces. One dataset (300, 30, 20, 10, 10) is rendered twice - the upper pie with default props, the lower pie with a minimum sector angle configured. Every boundary in the lower pie has rotated relative to the upper one even though the data is identical, which is the defect. The reproduction source in the pane is the only place the responsible prop is visible; the issue text does not name it.
